source: *yawn*
translation: *打哈欠*

source: H-Huh? Everyone’s left already…? Again?
translation: 咦、咦？大家已经走了……？又是这样？

source: *sigh* Just when I thought I’d be the first one up since everyone went to bed much later than I did.
translation: *叹气* 大家昨晚都比我睡得晚，我还以为自己会第一个起床呢。

source: I’m starting to feel like everyone’s really got their own thing to work on… while I just oversee everything but don’t actually get involved much…
translation: 我开始觉得大家都有自己真正要做的工作……而我只是监督一切，实际上却没怎么参与……

source: Ah, I shouldn’t be thinking this way…! I’ll just focus on finding where I can help out today.
translation: 啊，我不该这么想……！今天只要专心找找自己能帮上忙的地方就好。

source: Ah, I shouldn’t be thinking this way…! I’ll just focus on finding where I can help out today.{fast}
translation: 啊，我不该这么想……！今天只要专心找找自己能帮上忙的地方就好。{fast}

source: Ask about today's tasks.
translation: 询问今天的任务。

source: Actually… Maybe Sir Goro has something specific for me.
translation: 其实……也许Goro先生有具体的任务要交给我。

source: I better get dressed and head to his office.
translation: 我最好穿好衣服去他的办公室。

source: Report to the office.
translation: 去办公室汇报。

source: But before that, I have to make sure to report to the office first.
translation: 不过在那之前，我得先去办公室汇报。

source: Sir Goro will want to know how yesterday went.
translation: Goro先生应该会想知道昨天的情况。

source: Help out with chores.
translation: 帮忙做杂务。

source: Maybe I should go and see if I can help Aiden with his tasks.
translation: 也许我该去看看能不能帮Aiden完成他的工作。

source: I better get dressed and find him. He should be at the kitchen right now.
translation: 我最好穿好衣服去找他。他现在应该在厨房。

source: Assist with meal prep.
translation: 协助准备餐点。

source: Oh, Aiden needs some help again in the kitchen.
translation: 哦，Aiden又需要有人去厨房帮忙。

source: I better get dressed and head there.
translation: 我最好穿好衣服过去。

source: Looks like everyone’s having their breakfast. I still can’t get used to seeing this place so lively outside of the summer.
translation: 看来大家都在吃早餐。我还是不习惯在夏季以外看到这里这么热闹。

source: Oh…! Good morning, Jin!
translation: 哦……！早上好，Jin！

source: I was wondering where you—
translation: 我正想你去了哪——

source: Whoa! Y-Your nose is bleeding!
translation: 哇！你、你流鼻血了！

source: It’s hot as hell inside that kitchen, I tell you! I don’t know if I can handle the heat any longer…!!
translation: 告诉你，厨房里热得像地狱一样！我不知道自己还能不能继续承受那股热浪……！！

source: Oh my goodness, you might be having a heatstroke! Let’s get some cotton to stop the bleeding… or better yet, you should take a cold shower!
translation: 我的天，你可能中暑了！我们找点棉花止血……或者更好，你该去冲个冷水澡！

source: I don’t think even a shower could cool me down after what I just saw!
translation: 看过刚才那一幕后，我觉得就连冷水澡也没法让我降温！

source: Wh-What…?
translation: 什、什么……？

source: I came here for a snack, but I got a whole cake instead!
translation: 我本来只是来找点零食，结果却得到了一整块大蛋糕！

source: If you’ll excuse me, I need to savor this meal the heavens blessed me with!
translation: 失陪了，我得好好回味上天赐给我的这顿美餐！

source: W-Wait, Jin…!!
translation: 等、等等，Jin……！！

source: *sigh* I think I know exactly what he saw in there…
translation: *叹气* 我想我很清楚他在里面看到了什么……

source: Guess I’ll go see for myself.
translation: 看来我得亲自去看看。

source: {i}(It looks like Aiden is busy as usual…){/i}
translation: {i}（看来Aiden还是一如既往地忙碌……）{/i}

source: {i}(I don’t know how he’s always so energetic even while doing most of the strenuous chores around the camp.){/i}
translation: {i}（我不知道他承担着营地里大多数繁重杂务时，为什么还能总是这么精力充沛。）{/i}

source: {i}(But I have to admit, though, it’s really nice to see him in his element.){/i}
translation: {i}（不过我得承认，看他在擅长的领域大显身手，感觉真的很好。）{/i}

source: {i}(No wonder he makes such great food. He always cooks with so much passion){/i}
translation: {i}（难怪他做的食物那么美味。他做饭时总是充满热情。）{/i}

source: {i}(…and never with any clothes on.){/i}
translation: {i}（……而且从来不穿衣服。）{/i}

source: {i}(Not only that, but the  wind from the fan is lifting his apron up, showing a bit of his—){/i}
translation: {i}（不仅如此，风扇吹来的风还掀起了他的围裙，露出了一点他的——）{/i}

source: Oh! Hey there, Yoshi!
translation: 哦！嗨，Yoshi！

source: How long have you been standing there? I didn’t notice you come in at all!
translation: 你在那里站多久了？我完全没注意到你进来！

source: A-Ah, I—
translation: 啊、啊，我——

source: Huh? What’s with that look? And is that drool I see on your face?
translation: 嗯？你那副表情是怎么回事？而且你脸上的是口水吗？

source: Huh? What’s with that look? And is that drool I see on your face?{fast}
translation: 嗯？你那副表情是怎么回事？而且你脸上的是口水吗？{fast}

source: You’re covered in sweat…
translation: 你浑身都是汗……

source: N-No, I’m fine, but you’re covered in sweat…
translation: 不、不是，我没事，可你浑身都是汗……

source: Hehe, I wouldn’t mind you covering me in something else~
translation: 嘿嘿，我倒不介意让你用别的东西把我弄得满身都是～

source: Plus, I think you’d enjoy working up a sweat too, if you know what I mean~
translation: 而且我觉得你也会喜欢“挥汗运动”，你懂我的意思吧～

source: What’s for breakfast?
translation: 早餐吃什么？

source: I-I was just wondering what we’re having for breakfast.
translation: 我、我只是想问早餐吃什么。

source: Well, you can have \“these buns”\ for any meal you want~
translation: 这个嘛，无论哪一餐，你都可以享用“这对面包”～

source: Come and have a taste~! Grab ’em while they're hot!
translation: 快来尝尝吧～！趁热抓住它们！

source: I’m just feeling really thirsty…
translation: 我只是觉得很渴……

source: I-I’m just feeling really thirsty…
translation: 我、我只是觉得很渴……

source: Oho~ You came all the way here just to tell me that?
translation: 哦嚯～你大老远跑来就为了告诉我这个？

source: Well, I can make my special juice to help quench that “thirst” of yours~
translation: 这个嘛，我可以做一杯特制“果汁”，帮你解一解那份“渴”～

source: It’s really hot in here!
translation: 这里真的很热！

source: I-I’m just sweating…! It’s really hot in here.
translation: 我、我只是出汗了……！这里真的很热。

source: Is there anything I can do to help you cool down…?
translation: 有什么我能做的，帮你凉快下来吗……？

source: Hehe, I’d rather you turn up the “heat”, if you know what I mean~
translation: 嘿嘿，我倒希望你把“热度”再调高一点，你懂我的意思吧～

source: Th-That’s not what I meant, Aiden…!
translation: 我、我不是那个意思，Aiden……！

source: Hahaha! I’m just messing with you, Yoshi!
translation: 哈哈哈！我只是在逗你，Yoshi！

source: By the way, look – my kitchen finally has a fan! It’s funny how I never thought to add one in here before.
translation: 对了，快看——我的厨房终于有风扇了！真奇怪，我以前怎么从没想过在这里装一台。

source: A-Ah yeah, I noticed…! We should really improve the vents in here, huh?
translation: 啊、啊，是的，我注意到了……！我们确实该改善这里的通风，对吧？

source: Even during the colder months, you still have to put up with a hot kitchen.
translation: 就算在寒冷的月份，你也还是得忍受闷热的厨房。

source: Well, it’s a good thing we have Jin around now! He actually stopped by to drop this fan off a little while ago.
translation: 幸好现在有 Jin 在！其实他不久前刚顺路把这台风扇送来。

source: *sigh* No wonder he was so flustered…
translation: *叹气* 难怪他刚才那么慌张……

source: Did you warn him that you… uhh… do “this” to cool down?
translation: 你有没有提醒他，你会……呃……用“这种方式”降温？

source: Is this about the apron again? You guys should make that a part of the camp briefing already!
translation: 又是在说围裙吗？你们真该把这件事写进营地入职说明里！

source: His nose was bleeding, Aiden.
translation: 他流鼻血了，Aiden。

source: Huh… I probably hugged him too tight when I was thanking him for the fan. No wonder he left all of a sudden.
translation: 嗯……我感谢他送风扇时可能抱得太紧了。难怪他突然就跑了。

source: Come on, he’ll get used to it! Besides, everyone else seems to really like it so far!
translation: 拜托，他会习惯的！再说，到目前为止其他人似乎都很喜欢！

source: E-Everyone, else…?
translation: 其、其他所有人……？

source: Yep! The workers always cheer and holler at me whenever I bring them their meals!
translation: 没错！每次我给工人们送饭，他们都会对我欢呼起哄！

source: *sigh* I just really hope it’s the food they’re excited for.
translation: *叹气* 我真的希望他们兴奋的是食物。

source: Hehe, don’t pretend you don’t like it too – your face earlier said it all~
translation: 嘿嘿，别装作你也不喜欢——你刚才的表情已经说明一切了～

source: A-Aiden!
translation: 艾、Aiden！

source: Hahaha! I’m just teasing you!
translation: 哈哈哈！我只是在逗你！

source: Anyway, Aiden, I actually came here to ask if you needed any help with the kitchen work or any of your other tasks.
translation: 总之，Aiden，我来这里其实是想问问，你的厨房工作或其他任务需不需要帮忙。

source: Oh, not this time around. I’m making sure I finish all my prep work in the evenings now, especially after how much we crammed the other day.
translation: 哦，这次不用了。经历前几天那场赶工后，我现在会确保晚上就完成所有准备工作。

source: O-Oh, I see.
translation: 哦、哦，我明白了。

source: Eh? Are you free today or something?
translation: 咦？你今天没事做吗？

source: Well, I only need to oversee every aspect of this week’s checklist…
translation: 这个嘛，我只需要监督本周清单上的每个环节……

source: It’s pretty vague, but I’m trying my best to ask around and see if there’s anything I can help with.
translation: 这项职责很笼统，不过我正尽力四处询问，看看有什么能帮上忙的。

source: Aww, and I’m the first one you thought of? That’s really sweet, Yoshi~!
translation: 啊，而我就是你第一个想到的人？你真贴心，Yoshi～！

source: Well, if you really want to spend your day with me, why don’t you help me out with my other chores? I just finished up here, anyways.
translation: 好吧，如果你真的想和我共度一天，何不帮我做其他杂务？反正我这里刚好忙完了。

source: Oh, sure! What’s next on your task list?
translation: 哦，当然！你任务清单上的下一项是什么？

source: I was planning to head over to the obstacle course and clean the place up.
translation: 我本来打算去障碍训练场，把那里清理干净。

source: Oh right, that’s a good idea. I don’t think that was on my checklist – good thing you thought of it.
translation: 哦，对，这是个好主意。我想清单上没有这一项——幸好你想到了。

source: Should we head over there now?
translation: 我们现在过去吗？

source: Let me just serve this last batch I cooked up before we go out!
translation: 出发前，先让我把刚做好的最后这一批食物端出去！

source: Hehehe… Why? Is it for your eyes only~?
translation: 嘿嘿嘿……怎么？难道只能给你一个人看～？

source: Ohoho~ Since when did you get so possessive, Yoshi? I like it~
translation: 哦嚯嚯～Yoshi，你什么时候变得这么有占有欲了？我喜欢～

source: Whoa, you weren’t kidding when you said this place needed a cleanup…
translation: 哇，你说这里需要清理还真不是开玩笑……

source: Yeah, wait till you see the pool… It’s filthy!
translation: 是啊，等你看到泳池就知道了……脏得不得了！

source: I guess the autumn season made it worse too… Everything’s covered in leaves.
translation: 秋天大概也让情况变得更糟了……到处都盖满落叶。

source: Well, it’s been quite a while since we closed down, and nobody’s used it since the scouts, right?
translation: 毕竟营地关闭已经有一段时间了，而且童子军离开后就没人用过这里，对吧？

source: And you were planning to clean this all by yourself? There’s no way you could’ve finished it in a day…!
translation: 而你居然打算一个人清理这一切？你根本不可能一天做完……！

source: It’s a good thing you came to the rescue, huh? Haha!
translation: 幸好你来救场了，对吧？哈哈！

source: *sigh* I guess I have to check on you more often, or else you’ll keep doing these difficult chores on your own.
translation: *叹气* 看来我得更经常来看看你，不然你会一直独自承担这些辛苦的杂务。

source: Nah, don’t worry about me like that! I’m used to it! Besides, you have way more important stuff to do!
translation: 不用这样担心我！我已经习惯了！再说，你还有重要得多的事情要做！

source: Like what? Just stand around and watch everyone else all day?
translation: 比如什么？整天站在那里看其他人工作吗？

source: Hahaha! I guess it doesn’t sound bad at all when you put it that way!
translation: 哈哈哈！听你这么一说，感觉一点也不坏！

source: Anyway, looks like we have a lot to clean, huh? We better start now so we’ll finish before sundown.
translation: 总之，看来要清理的东西很多，对吧？最好现在就开始，这样才能在日落前完成。

source: Alright, then let’s start with the pool right away!
translation: 好，那我们马上从泳池开始！

source: Be careful, Aiden. It’s—
translation: 小心，Aiden。那里——

source: Wh-Whoa!
translation: 哇、哇啊！

source: A-Aiden!!
translation: 艾、Aiden！！

source: Are you alright?!
translation: 你没事吧？！

source: Yeah… I just slipped on my way down.
translation: 没事……我下去时只是滑了一跤。

source: Though I kinda landed on my elbow – it’s a good thing the leaves broke my fall.
translation: 不过我好像是手肘着地——幸好那些落叶缓冲了冲击。

source: {i}(I can’t help but remember how Aiden was back in the days…){/i}
translation: {i}（我不禁想起了Aiden从前的样子……）{/i}

source: {i}(I’m not sure if it’s because he gets overly excited whenever we hang out, but he’s always been extremely clumsy.){/i}
translation: {i}（不知道是不是因为每次和我们在一起他都会过度兴奋，但他一直都笨手笨脚的。）{/i}

source: {i}(I hope it’s not a bad thing, but I find that so endearing about him.){/i}
translation: {i}（希望这不算坏事，但我觉得他这一点真的很可爱。）{/i}

source: Here, let me help you up.
translation: 来，我扶你起来。

source: Thanks, Yoshi.
translation: 谢谢，Yoshi。

source: I’ll grab my first aid kit, and we’ll patch up that bruise!
translation: 我去拿急救箱，我们把那处伤口处理一下！

source: Watch out for the moss around the pool in this time of year. It gets really slippery when it’s damp.
translation: 每年这个时候都要小心泳池周围的苔藓。潮湿之后会非常滑。

source: Yeah, sorry about that… I wasn’t careful at all, Yoshi.
translation: 是啊，抱歉……我刚才一点也没留神，Yoshi。

source: Haha, you were clumsy, especially back in the days. You’d always show up with lots of bandages.
translation: 哈哈，你以前尤其冒失，总是贴着一大堆绷带出现。

source: Ahehe… At least it’s not as bad as before, right?
translation: 啊嘿嘿……至少现在没以前那么严重了，对吧？

source: You say that, but you slipped several times just this past summer.
translation: 你嘴上这么说，可就在刚过去的夏天，你还滑倒过好几次。

source: Hehe, like that time I spilled hot soup all over your pants~
translation: 嘿嘿，比如有一次我把热汤洒得你裤子上到处都是～

source: Thankfully, I caught you that time, so you didn’t get scraped up.
translation: 幸好那次我接住了你，所以你没有擦伤。

source: Anyway, you’re all patched up!
translation: 总之，伤口已经处理好了！

source: Thanks, Yoshi! You’re the best!
translation: 谢谢，Yoshi！你最好了！

source: I gotta say though… it feels really weird to have you take care of me like this.
translation: 不过我得说……像这样被你照顾，感觉真的很奇怪。

source: I gotta say though… it feels really weird to have you take care of me like this.{fast}
translation: 不过我得说……像这样被你照顾，感觉真的很奇怪。{fast}

source: I should watch over you more often.
translation: 我应该更经常照看你。

source: Seriously, I should watch over you more often.
translation: 说真的，我应该更经常照看你。

source: Oho, if you’ll be paying attention to me, then maybe I’ll have more “accidental” slip-ups~
translation: 哦嚯，如果你会一直关注我，那我或许该多来几次“意外”滑倒～

source: Don’t be silly, Aiden. You could’ve gotten seriously hurt.
translation: 别胡闹了，Aiden。你刚才可能会受重伤。

source: Come on, Yoshi. You know I’m kidding.
translation: 拜托，Yoshi。你知道我是在开玩笑。

source: What I’m trying to say is that you’ve always been doing things on your own while also watching out for all of us.
translation: 我想说的是，你一直独自做着各种事情，同时还照顾着我们所有人。

source: It's not a bad thing.
translation: 这并不是坏事。

source: It’s not a bad thing, Aiden.
translation: 这并不是坏事，Aiden。

source: Besides, you always try to hide it from me whenever something like this happens.
translation: 而且每当这种事发生时，你总想瞒着我。

source: Well… I just don’t wanna be a burden to you, you know?
translation: 这个嘛……我只是不想成为你的负担，你明白吗？

source: I never thought of you like that though.
translation: 但我从来没有那样看待过你。

source: It's the least I could do.
translation: 这是我至少能做的。

source: It’s the least I could do, Aiden.
translation: 这是我至少能为你做的，Aiden。

source: I don’t really get many chances to help you out like this.
translation: 我其实很少有机会像这样帮助你。

source: Aww, Yoshi~ It’s alright, you know I can handle myself, no problem.
translation: 啊，Yoshi～没关系的，你知道我能照顾好自己，完全没问题。

source: That’s true, but you still deserve to be taken care of every once in a while.
translation: 这倒是真的，但你偶尔也值得被别人照顾。

source: You’ve always been the one watching out for all of us.
translation: 一直以来，都是你在照看我们所有人。

source: Get used to it.
translation: 你得习惯。

source: You better get used to it, Aiden.
translation: 你最好习惯这件事，Aiden。

source: Now that I’m less busy this season, I’ll definitely be sticking around you more often.
translation: 这一季我没那么忙了，肯定会更经常待在你身边。

source: Yeah, it’ll be just like old times! We used to spend so much time together.
translation: 是啊，就像以前一样！我们过去总是花很多时间待在一起。

source: Haha, I had to keep an eye on you and make sure you’re not just working all day long.
translation: 哈哈，我得盯着你，确保你不会一整天只顾工作。

source: I know you try your best to be reliable, so much so that you’re willing to work on anything, whether it’s part of your job or not…
translation: 我知道你总想成为可靠的人，甚至愿意接下任何工作，不管那是不是你的职责……

source: Well… I do all those things because it makes me happy to help everyone out, but it’s also what I’ve always been used to growing up.
translation: 这个嘛……我做那些事，是因为帮助大家会让我开心，但那也是我从小到大早已习惯的生活方式。

source: I’ve never really had the luxury to pick or choose my own path, so I’ve gotten used to a simple life.
translation: 我从来没有随意选择人生道路的余裕，所以已经习惯了简单的生活。

source: …And I guess I’ve just gotten used to handling things on my own.
translation: ……我想，我也只是习惯了独自处理一切。

source: Especially after everything that happened with dad…
translation: 尤其是在父亲身上发生那些事之后……

source: Ah… I understand… I wasn’t there for you then...
translation: 啊……我明白……那时候我没能陪在你身边……

source: Well, we had to go our different paths after the first term. That’s just the way it worked out.
translation: 我们在第一期结束后不得不各奔东西。事情就是那样发展的。

source: But you know me! I’m a go-with-the-flow kinda guy, and I try to make do with whatever’s on my plate.
translation: 但你了解我！我是那种随遇而安的人，无论生活给我什么，我都会尽量应付。

source: That’s something I really admire about you, Aiden. I wish I were as optimistic as you.
translation: 这正是我非常钦佩你的地方，Aiden。真希望我也能像你一样乐观。

source: But you are though! Heck, you’re the one who helped me become like this!
translation: 可你本来就是啊！见鬼，正是你帮助我变成了现在这样！

source: Why do you think you’re different now? Are you overthinking again?
translation: 为什么你觉得自己现在不一样了？又在胡思乱想吗？

source: Well, I’ve had a really negative mindset about my role here at Camp Buddy for a while now…
translation: 这个嘛，这段时间我对自己在伙伴营的角色一直抱着很消极的想法……

source: You mean with the entire expansion project thingy?
translation: 你是说整个扩建项目的事情？

source: Yeah… I keep waking up every day ready to work, but I don’t have any specific jobs other than just overseeing things…
translation: 是啊……我每天醒来都做好了工作的准备，可除了监督一切之外，却没有任何具体任务……

source: Meanwhile, everyone else has their own exciting tasks that contribute to the project directly.
translation: 与此同时，其他人都有各自令人兴奋、能直接推进项目的任务。

source: You take care of the camp maintenance, Yuri handles the builders, and Sir Goro has the most important job of dealing with things behind the scenes.
translation: 你负责营地维护，Yuri管理施工人员，而Goro先生承担着最重要的工作，在幕后处理各种事务。

source: And all the new jobs that come up are being taken care of by the specialists.
translation: 至于新出现的工作，也全都有专家负责。

source: Everyone besides me has been doing such a good job lately…
translation: 最近除了我以外，每个人都做得那么好……

source: I just can’t help but feel… irrelevant.
translation: 我就是忍不住觉得……自己无关紧要。

source: What?! I can’t believe I’m hearing all of this from you!
translation: 什么？！真不敢相信这些话居然是从你嘴里说出来的！

source: I-I know it’s sounds stupid… I’m honestly embarrassed telling you all of this…
translation: 我、我知道这听起来很蠢……老实说，把这些全告诉你让我很难为情……

source: Come on, Yoshi! You’re like the foundation that keeps us all together here, you know!
translation: 拜托，Yoshi！你就像把这里所有人凝聚在一起的地基，明白吗！

source: I’m sure without you, Camp Buddy wouldn’t be nearly as successful, and the rest of us wouldn’t be so passionate about it!
translation: 我敢肯定，没有你，伙伴营绝不会像现在这样成功，我们其他人也不会对它抱有如此强烈的热情！

source: Heck, you held this place together when it’s about to fall apart for years now, and look what happened!
translation: 这些年来，每当这里快要分崩离析时，都是你把它撑了起来，再看看现在的成果！

source: We’re setting up for the best year ever, and so much of that is thanks to you!
translation: 我们正为有史以来最棒的一年做准备，而这很大程度上都要归功于你！

source: I really appreciate you saying all that, Aiden. I’m really flattered you see me like that.
translation: 谢谢你对我说这些，Aiden。你能这样看待我，真的让我受宠若惊。

source: I guess I’m just not used to the new environment yet… Camp Buddy is undergoing a huge change after all.
translation: 我想我只是还不习惯新环境……毕竟伙伴营正在经历巨大的变化。

source: You know, sometimes you just gotta learn to go with the flow and see where it takes you!
translation: 你知道吗，有时候就是要学会顺其自然，看看它会把你带向哪里！

source: You’re already doing everything you can, so try and look at things on the brighter side.
translation: 你已经尽己所能了，所以试着往积极的一面看吧。

source: Trust me, you’ll be a lot happier that way!
translation: 相信我，这样你会快乐得多！

source: You’re right, Aiden… It really helps me to see things from your perspective.
translation: 你说得对，Aiden……从你的角度看问题，真的对我很有帮助。

source: Thanks for cheering me up!
translation: 谢谢你让我振作起来！

source: It’s what I do best, Yoshi!
translation: 这可是我最擅长的事，Yoshi！

source: Now come on, the best way to get you out of a slump is to get your muscles pumping! Let’s get to cleaning!
translation: 好了，打起精神！摆脱低落情绪的最好办法，就是让肌肉动起来！我们开始清理吧！

source: Haha, alright!
translation: 哈哈，好吧！

source: {i}Talking with Aiden like that was really good for both of us… I think we both needed to get some things off our chest.{/i}
translation: {i}像这样和Aiden交谈，对我们两个人都很有好处……我想我们都需要把一些心事说出来。{/i}

source: {i}After our talk, we spent the rest of the day cleaning up the obstacle course.{/i}
translation: {i}谈话之后，我们用当天剩下的时间清理了障碍训练场。{/i}

source: {i}It was hard work, but we managed to finish it all just before sunset.{/i}
translation: {i}工作很辛苦，不过我们还是赶在日落前完成了全部清理。{/i}

source: *phew* Everything’s squeaky clean now!
translation: *呼* 现在一切都干净得发亮了！

source: I’m glad I was able to help. This would’ve been impossible to do by yourself.
translation: 很高兴我能帮上忙。只靠你一个人根本不可能完成。

source: Hahaha! You did save me a ton of time!
translation: 哈哈哈！你确实替我省下了大量时间！

source: Hey, Aiden.
translation: 嘿，Aiden。

source: Yeah?
translation: 怎么了？

source: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢你。

source: Eh, for what? Cleaning the pool?
translation: 咦，谢我什么？清理泳池吗？

source: N-No, I meant for the advice you gave me earlier.
translation: 不、不是，我是说谢谢你之前给我的建议。

source: It made me see things differently and be content with what I have today.
translation: 它让我换了个角度看待事情，也让我珍惜今天所拥有的一切。

source: Psh…! You’re cheesy as always, Yoshi!
translation: 噗……！你还是一如既往地肉麻，Yoshi！

source: H-Hey, I’m just really grateful of what I learned from you…!
translation: 喂、喂，我只是真的很感谢从你那里学到的东西……！

source: I learn a lot of things from you too. You just don’t realize it!
translation: 我也从你身上学到了很多。只是你自己没意识到！

source: Sometimes, I wish I could do all the leadership stuff that you can do! Totally fits the scoutmaster title.
translation: 有时候，我真希望自己也能像你一样做好那些领导工作！童子军教官这个称号太适合你了。

source: We just have different strengths, and together we make the perfect balance!
translation: 我们只是各有所长，而在一起正好能达到完美平衡！

source: Remember, we’ve got each other’s backs! Through thick and thin!
translation: 记住，我们会互相照应！无论顺境逆境！

source: Hehe, and you said I was the one who’s getting cheesy!
translation: 嘿嘿，你还说变得肉麻的人是我！

source: Oh, shut up! I blame you – your dorkiness is rubbing off on me.
translation: 哦，闭嘴！都怪你——你的傻气传染给我了。

source: But hey, I had fun too. Thanks for working with me today.
translation: 不过，我今天也很开心。谢谢你陪我一起工作。

source: You’re welcome, Aiden.
translation: 不客气，Aiden。

source: Anyways, we’re pretty grimy… Why don’t we head back to our cabin and get washed up?
translation: 总之，我们身上都脏透了……不如回小屋洗一洗？

source: Sheesh, we totally reek from all that pool sludge!
translation: 天啊，那些泳池污泥让我们臭死了！

source: A good, hot shower would be nice right now… It’s getting chillier each day!
translation: 现在能洗个舒服的热水澡就好了……天气一天比一天冷！

source: Hehe, I can wash your back if you want~ Or maybe you want me to go lower than that~
translation: 嘿嘿，如果你愿意，我可以帮你搓背～或者你想让我再往下洗一点～

source: *huff* *huff*
translation: *喘气* *喘气*

source: Whoa, you guys look beat! What have you been doing today?
translation: 哇，你们看起来累坏了！今天都做了些什么？

source: We started clearing out the site today! Had to chop lots of wood and move stuff around.
translation: 我们今天开始清理工地了！得砍很多木头，还要到处搬东西。

source: Sir Goro helped us too.
translation: Goro先生也来帮我们了。

source: We were a little behind schedule on the site clearing, so I decided to lend an extra hand.
translation: 工地清理的进度稍微落后了，所以我决定多帮一把。

source: I needed to stretch my muscles too… Working in the office all day made me stagnant.
translation: 我也需要活动一下肌肉……整天坐在办公室让我身体都僵住了。

source: Oh wow! I didn’t think you’d do that kind of job, sir…!
translation: 哦，哇！没想到您也会做那种工作，先生……！

source: Haha, you should’ve seen him with the axe! Those trees toppled down with just a couple swings!
translation: 哈哈，你真该看看他挥斧头的样子！只挥几下，那些树就倒了！

source: Dope.
translation: 真牛。

source: What about you two? You’re all covered in muck.
translation: 你们两个呢？全身都沾满了污泥。

source: We spent the day cleaning the obstacle course, and the pool was especially dirty.
translation: 我们花了一整天清理障碍训练场，尤其是泳池，脏得厉害。

source: Good morning, s—
translation: 早上好，先——

source: Hmm… Is Sir Goro not here? I wonder if he’s out again today.
translation: 嗯……Goro先生不在吗？不知道他今天是不是又出去了。

source: Oh? I think he’s still in his quarters…!
translation: 哦？我想他还在自己的房间里……！

source: I should go and check.
translation: 我应该去看看。

source: *snores*
translation: *打鼾*

source: {i}(I didn’t think Sir Goro would still be asleep… He’s usually the first one up){/i}
translation: {i}（没想到Goro先生居然还在睡……他通常都是第一个起床的人。）{/i}

source: {i}(I can’t blame him for sleeping in… He must be exhausted from his errands yesterday…){/i}
translation: {i}（也不能怪他睡过头……昨天四处奔波一定让他累坏了……）{/i}

source: {i}(Seeing him resting peacefully like this is kind of relieving though…){/i}
translation: {i}（不过看到他像这样安稳地休息，倒让我有些安心……）{/i}

source: {i}(He’s usually either slumped over paperwork on his desk or out all day handling important matters for the camp…){/i}
translation: {i}（平时他不是伏在桌前处理文件，就是整天在外面为营地处理重要事务……）{/i}

source: {i}(I’ve never really paid close attention before to how built and muscular he is… ){/i}
translation: {i}（以前我从没认真注意过，他的身材竟然这么健壮、肌肉这么发达……）{/i}

source: {i}(He’s kept himself perfectly fit throughout the years despite his busy schedule.){/i}
translation: {i}（尽管日程繁忙，这么多年来他依然把身体保持得极好。）{/i}

source: {i}(Not only that, but it seems like he’s been grooming himself, from the clean trim of his beard, the hairs on his chest, and all the way down to his—){/i}
translation: {i}（不仅如此，他似乎还精心打理过自己，从修剪整齐的胡须、胸毛，一路直到他的——）{/i}

source: {i}(I-Is this really all Sir Goro wears when he sleeps?){/i}
translation: {i}（吾、Goro先生睡觉时真的只穿这些吗？）{/i}

source: {i}(He’s normally so conservative, so I didn’t expect something this revealing from someone like him… ){/i}
translation: {i}（他平时那么保守，没想到像他这样的人会穿得如此暴露……）{/i}

source: Mmmhh…
translation: 嗯唔……

source: W… Wh-Wha… Yoshinori?
translation: 义……义、Yoshinori……？

source: W… Wh-Wha… Yoshinori?{fast}
translation: 义……义、Yoshinori……？{fast}

source: It’s time for breakfast!
translation: 该吃早餐了！

source: It’s time for sausage, sir!
translation: 该吃“香肠”了，先生！

source: H-Huh…?
I-I mean, i-it’s time for breakfast, sir…!
translation: 我、我是说，该、该吃早餐了，先生……！

source: {i}(Oh, crap! Why did I let that slip off my tongue?!){/i}
translation: {i}（糟糕！我为什么会脱口说出那种话？！）{/i}

source: I thought I heard something else… I’m still sort of groggy…
translation: 我还以为听到了别的话……我现在还有点迷糊……

source: Reporting for duty!
translation: 前来报到！

source: R-Reporting for daddy— I mean, DUTY…!!
translation: 前、前来向爹地报——我是说，报到执行任务……！！

source: For a second there, I thought I heard…
translation: 刚才有那么一瞬间，我还以为听到了……

source: Good morning, sir!
translation: 早上好，先生！

source: Wood morning, sir!
translation: 硬着呢，先生！（Wood morning, sir!）

source: Wait, what…?
translation: 等等，什么……？

source: GAH! I-I mean, good morning, sir!
translation: 啊！我、我是说，早上好，先生！

source: I'm ready, sir!
translation: 我准备好了，先生！

source: I’m ready for you, sir!
translation: 我已经为您准备好了，先生！

source: GAH! I-I mean, I’m ready for your orders, sir!
translation: 啊！我、我是说，我已准备好听候您的命令，先生！

source: *ehem* Anyway, I didn’t think you, of all people, would come into my room.
translation: *咳咳* 总之，我没想到偏偏是你会走进我的房间。

source: I-I apologize for walking into your private space, sir…!
translation: 很、很抱歉闯入您的私人空间，先生……！

source: It’s alright, Yoshinori. There’s no need for privacy, especially with you. We’ve gone hand in hand over the years.
translation: 没关系，Yoshinori。没有必要讲究隐私，尤其是在你面前。这些年来，我们一直携手同行。

source: I don’t think there’s anything wrong with it, Yoshinori. Or… is there?
translation: 我不觉得这有什么不妥，Yoshinori。还是说……有吗？

source: N-Not at all, sir! In fact, I think you look bulked up, sir!
translation: 完、完全没有，先生！事实上，我觉得您的身材又壮实了，先生！

source: You say that with your eyes down my—
translation: 你这么说时，眼睛却盯着我的——

source: AH! I was talking about your body, sir…!! I-It’s been a while since I’ve last seen you like this…
translation: 啊！我说的是您的身体，先生……！！我、我已经很久没见过您这副样子了……

source: Hahaha!! Don’t get too flustered, Yoshinori!
translation: 哈哈哈！！别这么慌张，Yoshinori！

source: Like I said a few days ago, I’m just trying to ease up around you more often.
translation: 就像几天前说的，我只是想在你面前多放松一些。

source: R-Right, sir…
translation: 是、是的，先生……

source: What time is it anyway? I must’ve overslept…
translation: 现在几点了？我一定睡过头了……

source: I-It’s nine in the morning, sir…!
translation: 现、现在是早上九点，先生……！

source: Ugh, I see… Let me get up then.
translation: 唔，我明白了……那我起床吧。

source: Thank you again for waking me up… It seems that my body clock isn’t properly tuned today.
translation: 再次谢谢你叫醒我……看来我今天的生物钟没有调整好。

source: I-It’s alright, Sir Goro! Honestly, I didn’t expect to wake you when I first came in here!
translation: 没、没关系，Goro先生！老实说，我刚进来时根本没想到会叫醒您！

source: Well, it’s a good thing you did, or else I wouldn’t have been able to work on my checklist today.
translation: 幸好你这么做了，否则我今天就没法处理清单上的工作了。

source: Ah… About that, sir…! That was the reason I was looking for you!
translation: 啊……说到这个，先生……！这正是我来找您的原因！

source: I was wondering if there was anything I could do to assist you with your tasks.
translation: 我想问问，有没有什么能让我协助您完成任务的地方。

source: Hmm… Actually, I was planning to oversee the construction today.
translation: 嗯……其实我今天打算去监督施工。

source: Based on the report Yuri gave me last night, it looks like they are a day behind on the site clearing.
translation: 根据Yuri昨晚给我的报告，工地清理的进度似乎落后了一天。

source: I’ve been swamped with management tasks and missing out on what’s actually going on in each department.
translation: 我一直被管理工作压得喘不过气，也因此不了解各部门实际发生的情况。

source: I want to check and see how things are going for myself and see if there’s anything I can do to help.
translation: 我想亲自去看看进展如何，也看看自己能不能帮上什么忙。

source: Why don’t you come along with me?
translation: 你何不和我一起去？

source: Oh, sure! I’d be happy to help, sir!
translation: 哦，当然！我很乐意帮忙，先生！

source: Great, then I should probably get dressed.
translation: 很好，那我大概该穿上衣服了。

source: Unless… you’re not finished with the view?
translation: 除非……你还没欣赏够眼前的风景？

source: A-Ah…! I-I’ll just wait for you outside, sir…!
translation: 啊、啊……！我、我还是去外面等您吧，先生……！

source: Wait, Yoshinori, I’m just—
translation: 等等，Yoshinori，我只是——

source: I-I’m sorry again for invading your privacy, sir…!!
translation: 再、再次为侵犯您的隐私道歉，先生……！！

source: Oh! Hi, Dad and Yoshi!
translation: 哦！嗨，爸爸、Yoshi！

source: Good morning, Yuri. Did you gather everyone for our work? I was hoping we could get back on schedule today.
translation: 早上好，Yuri。你把大家召集起来工作了吗？我希望今天能把进度赶回来。

source: Ah, yes! Yesterday, we were able to survey the land and mark the trees we’ll need to cut down.
translation: 啊，是的！昨天我们勘测了土地，并标记了需要砍倒的树木。

source: I don’t think that we’ll be able to finish all the chopping today, unfortunately…
translation: 不过很遗憾，我觉得今天没法完成全部砍伐工作……

source: Even though we have a big team, there’s just a ton of trees and clutter to get rid of.
translation: 虽然团队人数不少，但要清除的树木和杂物实在太多了。

source: Hmm, I see…
translation: 嗯，我明白了……

source: Lloyd, do you have an estimate for when you think we can finish the site clearing phase?
translation: Lloyd，你估计工地清理阶段什么时候能完成？

source: With the current workforce, we should be done in around two to three days.
translation: 以目前的人手，大约两到三天可以完成。

source: I have to file a report to Mr. Clermont by the end of the week, so that means we have to finish the weekly checklist before then.
translation: 我必须在周末前向Clermont先生提交报告，也就是说，我们得在那之前完成本周清单。

source: That’s partly my fault, sir. I didn’t foresee that the expansion site would have this much vegetation. I should’ve conducted the survey earlier.
translation: 这部分是我的责任，先生。我没预料到扩建场地会有这么茂密的植被，应该更早进行勘测。

source: Please, it’s no one’s fault. I’m sure Mr. Clermont will understand if there are minor adjustments to our schedule.
translation: 不必自责，这不是任何人的错。我相信日程稍作调整，Clermont先生会理解的。

source: Besides, I think we can cut down the work too by reducing the amount of trees we’ll take down.
translation: 此外，我认为还可以减少需要砍伐的树木数量，从而降低工作量。

source: I believe that if we conserve some of them, they’ll complement the structures we’re building here.
translation: 我相信保留一部分树木，能让它们与这里将建造的设施相得益彰。

source: That’s an excellent idea, sir! I can easily adjust the site development plan to retain some of the trees and incorporate the camp’s aesthetics!
translation: 好主意，先生！我可以轻松调整场地开发方案，保留部分树木，并融入营地的美学风格！

source: Good thinking, Dad~!
translation: 想得真周到，爸爸～！

source: On top of that, we’ll make sure to work overtime today to speed things up a bit!
translation: 除此之外，我们今天也会加班，尽量加快进度！

source: Well, maybe I could help out as well? I was planning to be more hands-on today anyway.
translation: 那么，也许我也可以帮忙？反正我今天本来就打算多亲自动手。

source: You don’t need to, sir! You can leave it to me and Yuri to supervise everyone!
translation: 您不必这样，先生！监督大家的工作交给我和Yuri就行！

source: He meant with chopping trees, Lloyd.
translation: 他的意思是帮忙砍树，Lloyd。

source: Wh-What?! Sir Goro… the camp president… is gonna chop wood with us???
translation: 什、什么？！Goro先生……营地负责人……要和我们一起砍木头？？？

source: Yes, and I’m here to volunteer too! This wouldn’t be a new thing to us anyway! Sir Goro, Aiden and I have a rotation for chopping firewood!
translation: 是的，我也来当志愿者！反正这对我们并不新鲜！Goro先生、Aiden和我一直轮流砍柴！

source: Hihi, how did you guys think my dad got so buff? He’s always been a fan of working out~
translation: 嘻嘻，你们以为我爸爸这一身肌肉是怎么练出来的？他一直都很喜欢锻炼～

source: I’ve spent too much time behind a desk recently, and I’m eager to stretch my muscles.
translation: 最近我坐在办公桌后的时间太多了，正想活动一下肌肉。

source: Wow, now it all makes sense that you’ve always been so fit, sir… This camp really struck gold with its leader…
translation: 哇，现在终于明白您为什么一直这么健壮了，先生……这座营地真是捡到了一位宝藏领导者……

source: Brains and brawn.
translation: 有勇有谋。

source: Anyway, we should make the most of the daylight. Let me just gear up, and we’ll start working.
translation: 总之，我们应该充分利用白天。等我换好装备，就开始工作。

source: Alright, I’m ready.
translation: 好了，我准备好了。

source: It’s been a while since I’ve seen you chop wood, sir.
translation: 我已经很久没看您砍木头了，先生。

source: I have to admit, I might be a little rusty now from doing nothing but paperwork for weeks.
translation: 我得承认，连续几周只处理文书工作，动作可能有点生疏了。

source: I’m sure you’re still in perfect shape, sir!
translation: 我相信您的状态依然完美，先生！

source: Heh, how about we make it a challenge and see who chops down the most today?
translation: 呵，不如来场比赛，看看今天谁砍倒的树最多？

source: Ahehe… I-I don’t think I’ll be able to keep up with you, sir.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……我、我觉得自己跟不上您，先生。

source: Where’s your competitive spirit, Yoshinori? You didn’t build those arms for nothing, right?
translation: 你的好胜心去哪了，Yoshinori？那双手臂总不是白练的吧？

source: A-Ah, well…
translation: 啊、啊，这个……

source: Hmph. Or is it because you think I won’t stand a chance just because you’re younger?
translation: 哼。还是说，你觉得自己更年轻，我根本没有胜算？

source: N-No, not at all, sir! That’s not what I was thinking!
translation: 不、完全不是，先生！我绝没有那么想！

source: Then grab an axe and show me what you got~!
translation: 那就拿起斧头，让我看看你的本事～！

source: GAH!
translation: 喝啊！

source: ARGH!!
translation: 啊啊！！

source: {i}(With just a few powerful swings, Sir Goro was able to topple down his first tree.){/i}
translation: {i}（Goro先生只用几次强劲的挥砍，就放倒了第一棵树。）{/i}

source: {i}(It’s crazy what those arms can do…){/i}
translation: {i}（那双手臂的力量实在惊人……）{/i}

source: Heh! Are you keeping up, Yoshinori?!
translation: 呵！还跟得上吗，Yoshinori？！

source: I-I’m working on it, s-sir…!
translation: 我、我正在努力，先、先生……！

source: Come on, the wood’s not even hard at all! Put some more force into it!
translation: 加油，这木头根本不硬！再多使点力！

source: HNGH!
translation: 嗯啊！

source: TIMBER!!
translation: 树倒了！！

source: Hahahaha! Not bad, Yoshinori!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！不错，Yoshinori！

source: {i}(Everyone’s starting to watch Sir Goro as he fells each tree… I don’t blame them – I can’t help but look too.){/i}
translation: {i}（大家都开始看着Goro先生一棵接一棵地伐倒树木……不能怪他们，我也忍不住一直看。）{/i}

source: {i}(It reminds me of when I watched him do this every morning…){/i}
translation: {i}（这让我想起过去每天早晨看他做这件事的时候……）{/i}

source: {i}(Sir Goro has always loved to keep himself in shape no matter what the task.){/i}
translation: {i}（无论在做什么工作，Goro先生一直都喜欢让自己保持良好体形。）{/i}

source: {i}(Even after all these years, he’s had that same display of strength that really made me look up to him even more.){/i}
translation: {i}（这么多年过去，他依旧展现着同样的力量，让我更加敬仰他。）{/i}

source: {i}(In fact, he’s the reason I started working out in the first place.){/i}
translation: {i}（事实上，我当初正是因为他才开始锻炼。）{/i}

source: What’s the matter, Yoshinori? Running out of breath already?
translation: 怎么了，Yoshinori？已经喘不过气了吗？

source: A-Ah, a little, sir…!
translation: 啊、啊，有一点，先生……！

source: Hahaha, let’s take a break for a while, then!
translation: 哈哈哈，那就休息一会儿吧！

source: I'm surprised, Yoshinori. You're not usually winded so easily.
translation: 真让我惊讶，Yoshinori。你平时可不会这么容易喘。

source: Haha, what happened to the scout who never ran out of energy back then?
translation: 哈哈，过去那个精力永远用不完的童子军去哪了？

source: Ah, hehe… I've always had trouble keeping up with you, sir.
translation: 啊，嘿嘿……我一直都很难跟上您，先生。

source: I mean… you’re the toughest guy I’ve ever known.
translation: 我是说……您是我见过最强壮的人。

source: Heh, I'm not sure about all that. I'm just glad I was able to get out here and actually be involved today.
translation: 呵，这话我可不敢当。我只是很高兴今天能走出来，真正参与其中。

source: That's actually something I really admire about you, sir!
translation: 这其实正是我非常敬佩您的地方，先生！

source: You were able to jump in today and provide solutions right away, and you didn't hesitate to get involved either.
translation: 您今天一加入就立刻提出了解决方案，而且亲自动手时也毫不犹豫。

source: I wish I had that same kind of confidence and ability to take charge when needed.
translation: 真希望自己也拥有那种自信，以及在需要时挺身而出主持大局的能力。

source: Huh? What makes you think you don't, Yoshinori?
translation: 嗯？为什么你觉得自己没有，Yoshinori？

source: Are you having the same doubts you talked about a few days ago?
translation: 你又在怀疑几天前提到的那些事吗？

source: Well, it’s not that big of a deal… But yes, I’ve never been able to fully shake off my negative mindset about my role here at Camp Buddy…
translation: 其实也不是什么大事……但确实，我始终没能完全摆脱对自己在伙伴营所扮演角色的消极想法……

source: You’re talking about your role for this expansion project, right?
translation: 你说的是自己在这次扩建项目中的角色，对吧？

source: Aiden takes care of the camp maintenance, Yuri handles the builders, and you have the most important job of dealing with things behind the scenes.
translation: Aiden负责营地维护，Yuri管理施工人员，而您承担着最重要的工作，在幕后处理各种事务。

source: Yoshinori…
translation: Yoshinori……

source: I-I know it’s sounds stupid… I’m honestly embarrassed telling you all of this, sir…
translation: 我、我知道这听起来很蠢……老实说，把这些告诉您让我很难为情，先生……

source: No, it’s alright…
translation: 不，没关系……

source: It’s perfectly normal to feel a little out of place with the current state of the camp.
translation: 面对营地目前的状态，感到有些找不到位置是完全正常的。

source: But remember – you’re a scoutmaster. Your job is to take care of the scouts and engage with them.
translation: 但要记住——你是童子军教官。你的职责是照顾童子军，并带领他们参与活动。

source: And because it’s the off-season, that role naturally feels empty to you right now.
translation: 现在正值休营期，所以你自然会觉得这个角色无事可做。

source: So, give it some time, and let yourself adjust. It’s been less than a week since the expansion project kicked off after all.
translation: 所以给自己一点时间去适应。毕竟扩建项目启动至今还不到一周。

source: Th-Thank you, sir… I really appreciate your advice.
translation: 谢、谢谢您，先生……我真的很感激您的建议。

source: Well, I’m glad you still trust me enough to tell me your doubts and concerns.
translation: 我很高兴你仍然足够信任我，愿意告诉我这些疑虑和担忧。

source: It’s been a long time since we got to talk like this, and it really brought me back to the days when I was there to guide you as your scoutmaster.
translation: 我们已经很久没有这样谈心了，这真的让我想起从前作为你的教官引导你的日子。

source: Although, you were always the one who listened when I had problems with my family.
translation: 不过，当我的家庭出现问题时，一直都是你在倾听。

source: Ah… I really didn’t mind, sir. In fact, I was more than happy to be someone you could talk to.
translation: 啊……我真的不介意，先生。事实上，能成为您愿意倾诉的人，我非常高兴。

source: You really did help me get through some tough times, and I owe you a lot for that.
translation: 你确实帮我熬过了一些艰难时刻，为此我欠你很多。

source: And yet, I became so distant over the years that I couldn’t even return the favor.
translation: 然而这些年来，我变得如此疏远，甚至没能回报你。

source: Yet I’ve become so distant over the years that I couldn’t even return the favor.{fast}
translation: 然而这些年来，我变得如此疏远，甚至没能回报你。{fast}

source: It couldn't be helped.
translation: 那也是无可奈何。

source: It couldn’t be helped, sir… There’s nothing we can do to change what’s already happened…
translation: 那也是无可奈何，先生……已经发生的事，我们无法改变……

source: It's all in the past.
translation: 一切都过去了。

source: It doesn’t matter now, sir, ’cause it’s all in the past…
translation: 现在已经没关系了，先生，因为一切都过去了……

source: I don’t hold anything against you.
translation: 我并不怪您。

source: I don’t hold anything against you, sir…
translation: 我并不怪您，先生……

source: You were going through a lot.
translation: 您当时承受了太多。

source: But I understand that you were going through a lot of things I didn’t know about, sir…
translation: 但我明白，您当时正经历许多我不知道的事情，先生……

source: Since I left after the first term, you had to manage everything on your own… I can only imagine how much more difficult it was to be in your shoes.
translation: 第一期结束后我就离开了，您不得不独自管理一切……我只能想象，处在您的位置上会有多么艰难。

source: Well… I do believe everything happens for a reason.
translation: 这个嘛……我确实相信每件事的发生都有原因。

source: And all we can do is control how we respond to those events and try our best no matter the circumstances.
translation: 我们能做的，只有掌控自己如何回应那些事情，并在任何处境下都竭尽全力。

source: Haha, that kinda reminds me of the Buddy Law, sir.
translation: 哈哈，这有点让我想起伙伴守则，先生。

source: *ehem* I didn’t mean to sound so sentimental.
translation: *咳咳* 我不是故意说得这么感伤。

source: Well, I feel a lot more motivated now! Thank you, Sir Goro.
translation: 好了，我现在有动力多了！谢谢您，Goro先生。

source: Good. Now channel that motivation into that axe, and let’s get back to chopping.
translation: 很好。现在把那股动力注入斧头，我们继续砍吧。

source: {i}(I’m really glad Sir Goro and I had our talk… It really made me feel better to know that we understand each other....){/i}
translation: {i}（我真的很庆幸和Goro先生谈了这些……知道我们能够理解彼此，让我感觉好多了……）{/i}

source: {i}(After our talk, we spent the rest of the day chopping up more trees.){/i}
translation: {i}（谈话之后，我们用当天剩下的时间砍倒了更多树木。）{/i}

source: {i}(It was hard work, but we managed to finish it all just before sunset.){/i}
translation: {i}（工作很辛苦，不过我们还是赶在日落前完成了。）{/i}

source: *huff* *huff* That might be the most trees I’ve chopped down in my life…
translation: *喘气* *喘气* 这可能是我一生中砍树最多的一次……

source: Looks like we don’t have to worry about firewood for the winter. I even think these might last us till next year.
translation: 看来这个冬天不用担心柴火了。我甚至觉得这些能用到明年。

source: I have to say, you’re not too shabby after all, Yoshinori. You managed to keep up with me.
translation: 我得说，你终究还是挺不错的，Yoshinori。居然跟上了我。

source: No way, sir… I only took down about half as many as you did. I didn’t stand a chance of winning that challenge, haha.
translation: 差远了，先生……我砍倒的树只有您一半左右，根本没机会赢下比赛，哈哈。

source: Heh, you tried. It was a good workout though, wasn’t it?
translation: 呵，你已经努力了。不过这确实是很好的锻炼，对吧？

source: Ah, hehe… You don’t look like you’re tired at all, sir.
translation: 啊，嘿嘿……您看起来一点都不累，先生。

source: Don’t get me wrong, I have my limits too. I could really use a massage tonight.
translation: 别误会，我也有极限。今晚真该好好按摩一下。

source: Oh, I can give you one if you—
translation: 哦，如果您愿意，我可以替您——

source: Wow! Everything’s cleared over here! Good job, you two!
translation: 哇！这边全都清理干净了！你们两个干得漂亮！

source: Ah, looks like you all have cleared up over there as well. Great work.
translation: 啊，看来你们那边也清理完了。干得很好。

source: Yeah, Dar was chopping trees down like crazy! I wish I could’ve helped as much as you guys though.
translation: 是啊，Dar砍树简直像疯了一样！不过真希望我也能像你们一样帮上那么多忙。

source: You helped carry the wood.
translation: 你帮忙搬了木头。

source: Yeah, everyone really worked hard today!  The place looks a lot bigger without all the vegetation.
translation: 是啊，今天大家真的都很努力！植被清掉后，这片地方看起来大多了。

source: Looking at it all cleared like this makes me realize how much larger Camp Buddy’s property is.
translation: 看到这里全部清理干净，我才意识到伙伴营的占地比想象中大得多。

source: Yeah, this is probably one of the biggest sites I’ve ever worked on! I’m really excited to start ground-breaking soon!
translation: 是啊，这可能是我参与过最大的工地之一！真期待尽快开始破土施工！

source: We should be back on schedule now, right?
translation: 我们现在应该赶上进度了吧？

source: I’d say we’re at about 80\% completion of the original target! You guys can leave the rest for us tomorrow, and we’ll finish it before sunset!
translation: 我认为原定目标已经完成约 80\%！剩下的明天交给我们，日落前一定完成！

source: Excellent. And since it’s already sundown, I believe we can all call it a day.
translation: 很好。既然太阳已经落山，我想今天可以收工了。

source: Great job, everyone!
translation: 大家干得漂亮！

source: Hihi~ Now, if you boys don’t mind, I have to wash up~ I got dirty from trying to carry stuff around too~
translation: 嘻嘻～好了，如果男士们不介意，我得去洗洗～搬东西也把我弄脏了～

source: If that’s the case, then I’ll have to shower elsewhere.
translation: 既然如此，那我得去别处洗澡了。

source: You can use the ones in our quarters, sir! We have several cubicles there!
translation: 您可以用我们住处的淋浴间，先生！那里有好几个隔间！

source: Ooh~? I smell something fishy~
translation: 哦～？我闻到了可疑的味道～

source: Hngh! No way! I don’t have body odor, just so you know!
translation: 嗯啊！才不是！告诉你，我可没有体味！

source: Even your sweat smells good.
translation: 就连你的汗都很好闻。

source: A-Anyway, should we all go now before it gets chilly out here?
translation: 总、总之，趁这里还没变冷，我们现在走吧？

source: Hihihi~ Have funnn~~
translation: 嘻嘻嘻～玩得开心哦～～

source: Hey, guys!
translation: 嘿，各位！

source: A-Aiden! What happened to you? You’re a mess!
translation: 艾、Aiden！你怎么了？浑身脏兮兮的！

source: Eugh… And you reek too… Did you fall in the dumpster or something?
translation: 呃……而且你还臭死了……你掉进垃圾箱了吗？

source: Whoops, sorry! I cleaned the pool today, and I guess a lot of sludge got onto me!
translation: 哎呀，抱歉！我今天清理了泳池，大概沾上了很多污泥！

source: You guys are ones to talk! You’re all covered in dirt!
translation: 你们还好意思说！你们自己也满身泥土！

source: Whoa! Good thing you didn’t hurt your back, Gramps!
translation: 哇！幸好你没闪到腰，Gramps！

source: He actually chopped down the most out of everyone, Aiden…
translation: 其实所有人里，他砍倒的树最多，Aiden……

source: Awesooome! Didn’t know you still had it in you, Gramps! Hahaha!
translation: 太——棒了！没想到你还宝刀未老，Gramps！哈哈哈！

source: Hnnn… Good morning, guys…
translation: 嗯……早上好，各位……

source: What? It’s, like, eight in the evening! You’re way off!
translation: 什么？现在都晚上八点左右了！你差得也太远了！

source: Ahh… I’m sorry, I must’ve overslept a little… Did I miss anything?
translation: 啊……抱歉，我一定稍微睡过头了……我错过什么了吗？

source: Wait a minute! You were sleeping all day while all of us were working our asses off?!
translation: 等一下！我们所有人累死累活时，你居然睡了一整天？！

source: Ack…! I-It’s not what you think! I wasn’t slacking off…!
translation: 啊……！不、不是你想的那样！我没有偷懒……！

source: Jin’s telling the truth though. He was up all night yesterday working on his laptop, and he was still awake when I got up this morning to make breakfast.
translation: 不过 Jin 说的是真的。他昨晚通宵用笔记本电脑工作，今天早上我起来做早餐时他还醒着。

source: Wait… Does that mean you haven’t slept since you got here, Jin?!
translation: 等等……这是不是说，你来到这里后就一直没睡过，Jin？！

source: Well, I have now… But yeah, I didn’t really sleep the night before either…
translation: 这个嘛，我现在睡过了……不过是的，前一晚我也没怎么睡……

source: Yikes… I don’t know how you do that. I don’t function well without my eight hours of REM sleep!
translation: 天啊……真不知道你怎么办到的。没有八小时快速眼动睡眠，我根本没法正常运转！

source: He’s a night owl.
translation: 他是个夜猫子。

source: Yeah… That’s right! I’m more focused and productive during the night!
translation: 是啊……没错！我晚上更专注，效率也更高！

source: I suppose you work better during those hours, but isn’t that a little… unhealthy?
translation: 我想你确实在那些时段工作得更好，可那不是有点……不健康吗？

source: Yeah, I agree… Do you have trouble sleeping, Jin?
translation: 是啊，我也这么觉得……你有睡眠障碍吗，Jin？

source: I-I’m fine…! Please don’t worry about me.
translation: 我、我没事……！请别担心我。

source: Have you tried sipping a nice, warm cup of chamomile tea before bed? It’s a natural and organic treatment for insomnia!
translation: 你试过睡前喝一杯温暖舒适的洋甘菊茶吗？那可是天然有机的失眠疗法！

source: Darius usually has trouble sleeping sometimes as well, and it works wonders for him.
translation: Darius有时也睡不好，而它对他特别有效。

source: I like tea.
translation: 我喜欢茶。

source: If that can knock this big guy out, that should solve your insomnia problems!
translation: 既然它能让这个大块头睡着，肯定也能解决你的失眠问题！

source: But… I don’t have insomnia.
translation: 可是……我并没有失眠。

source: Give him a break, guys. His brain is just more active at night. There’s nothing more to it~
translation: 放过他吧，各位。他的大脑只是晚上更活跃，没别的原因～

source: That’s right. Besides, Jin’s tasks do not need to follow a strict daily schedule. As long as he gets the job done, then there’s no problem.
translation: 没错。而且 Jin 的任务不必遵守严格的日程，只要把工作完成就没问题。

source: I guess if he does it all the time then his body must have already developed its own circadian rhythm.
translation: 我想既然他一直这样，身体肯定已经形成了自己的昼夜节律。

source: You really don’t want to let this go, huh, Lloyd?
translation: 你还真不肯放过这个话题，对吧，Lloyd？

source: Haha.
translation: 哈哈。

source: F-Forgive me for asking, but… I’ve been wondering why everyone’s covered in dirt… Did something happen out there while I was asleep?
translation: 请、请原谅我多问，不过……为什么大家身上都沾满泥土……我睡觉时外面发生什么了吗？

source: Oh, we all just worked on physical tasks today! We should probably get washed up now though, huh?
translation: 哦，我们今天都做了体力活！不过现在大概该去洗一洗了，对吧？

source: Ugh! I’ve been wanting to do that since we got back here! This dirty, sticky sweat is really bad for my skin!
translation: 呃！从回来后我就一直想洗！这种又脏又黏的汗对皮肤太糟糕了！

source: Oh, you guys are gonna take a shower?
translation: 哦，你们要去洗澡吗？

source: Yeah! Are you planning on using the bathroom, Jin?
translation: 是啊！你也打算用浴室吗，Jin？

source: W-Well, I was about to… I really haven’t got the chance to shower ever since I got here…
translation: 这、这个，我正准备去……自从来到这里，我还真的一直没机会洗澡……

source: But you guys can go ahead! I can be at the back of the queue!
translation: 不过你们先去吧！我可以排在最后！

source: Back of the queue? The bathroom’s big enough for all of us.
translation: 排在最后？浴室大得足够容纳我们所有人。

source: To save time, water, and heating, here at Camp Buddy, we shower TOGETHER!
translation: 为了节省时间、用水和供暖，在伙伴营，我们都是一起洗澡的！

source: FDJASKLFSAFLK! What?! T-TOGETHER?!
translation: 啊叽里呱啦！什么？！一、一起洗？！

source: Oh yeah, we used to do that all the time when we were scouts too!
translation: 对啊，我们以前当童子军时也总是一起洗！

source: Do you need me to wash your back again?
translation: 还需要我再帮你搓背吗？

source: H-Hey! My arms are long enough now to reach!
translation: 喂、喂！我现在手臂够长，自己能够到了！

source: W-Wait… I-I’ve never really taken a shower with someone else, but—
translation: 等、等等……我、我从没真的和别人一起洗过澡，可是——

source: No buts! Oh wait… Actually, there’ll be a lot of butts.
translation: 没有可是！哦等等……其实会有很多“屁股”。

source: We’re all men here. There’s nothing to be embarrassed about.
translation: 这里都是男人，没什么好害羞的。

source: Now, now, guys. If Jin isn’t comfortable with it, maybe we shouldn’t—
